title: Returned-Payment Charge by Remittance Channel — Home Purchase Financing
content:
**Fee table by remittance channel — Home Purchase Financing loans**

The return channel charge of a returned-payment fee depends on how the returned payment came in. The returned payment is the payment that the newest return on the loan — the one being charged — points to, and its channel is the channel recorded on that payment.

Where the returned payment was an autopay draft, the return channel charge is 15.00; where it was a one-time phone or online portal ACH payment, the return channel charge is 20.00. For a returned payment that came in any other way — a mailed check, a cashier's check or a money order — no channel-specific charge is set by this table.

| Channel of the returned payment | Return channel charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| ACH autopay draft | 15.00 |
| one-time phone ACH payment | 20.00 |
| one-time online portal ACH payment | 20.00 |
| mailed check | not set by this table |
| cashier's check at the office | not set by this table |
| money order at the office | not set by this table |

*Hypothetical cases.* The newest return points to an installment paid by autopay: 15.00. The newest return points to an installment paid by phone ACH, while an older return on the loan was of an autopay draft: the newest return decides, so 20.00.
